script_text: Taurus, the cosmos just flipped a switch — this week will challenge everything you thought you knew about your power. Mercury squares Saturn in your 10th House on Monday, making career communication frustrating and delayed. Wednesday, the Sun opposes Venus, stirring tension in partnerships and finances. By Thursday, Venus enters your 5th House, shifting everything — creativity and romance flood back into your life. The weekend brings a sextile between Mars and Jupiter activating your 8th House for shared resources. Saturday's Moon trines your natal Sun, granting clarity. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, igniting passion and creative breakthroughs. Wednesday is your worst day because the Sun opposes Venus while squaring Saturn, blocking career progress and straining relationships. Trust your Earth element instincts — slow down, ground yourself, and let Venus guide your decisions rather than reacting to pressure. Follow for daily updates.
